summary:
ORBIT ARCHITECT is an interactive educational space mission design game developed by Team SAWAN for the Space Mission Design Game challenge.
Players take the role of mission planners and build missions by selecting destinations, objectives, spacecraft, launch vehicles, power systems, communication systems, and scientific instruments.
The game evaluates key design constraints, including budget, payload mass, power availability, and communication requirements. It provides instant feedback and recommendations to help players understand engineering trade-offs. Players can launch a mission simulation and receive a performance report with a game-generated score.
Our goal is to make space mission planning engaging and accessible while encouraging scientific curiosity, critical thinking, and engineering decision-making.
Built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as a browser-based prototype. All engineering values and scores are simplified educational game models, not official NASA specifications.
details:
ORBIT ARCHITECT – Space Mission Design Simulator

ORBIT ARCHITECT is an educational space mission design game developed by Team SAWAN. It allows users to design a virtual space mission by selecting a destination such as the Moon, Mars, or Deep Space, choosing a mission objective, spacecraft, launch vehicle, power system, communication system, and scientific instruments.

The simulator evaluates the selected mission configuration using simplified game rules and provides feedback through a mission performance report and score. Users can experiment with different combinations and understand how engineering choices affect mission success.

The project aims to make space mission planning interactive, engaging, and accessible to students. It was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as a browser-based application.

The simulation is educational and uses simplified assumptions; its scores and calculations are not official NASA engineering predictions.
